data.desc: KBR is a global technology and services company helping customers solve complex challenges across energy, food and agriculture, and industrial and critical infrastructure markets. Combining differentiated technology, engineering and operational expertise, and global delivery capabilities, KBR works across the asset lifecycle to help customers shape investments, deliver projects and optimize operations. With approximately 16,000 employees across more than 30 countries, KBR is focused on delivering better outcomes for customers in markets critical to the world's future.
